boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of Alabama traditions spanning game day, campus milestones, and shared ceremonies.

cards.title: Elephant Stomp
cards.subtitle: Gorgas Library steps before home football kickoff
cards.notes: Arrive at Gorgas Library about an hour before kickoff to watch the Million Dollar Band and cheer squad’s pregame presentation.
cards.short_summary: A pregame gathering centered on the Million Dollar Band and UA cheerleading squad.
cards.evidence_claim: UA’s official gameday site says Elephant Stomp takes place at Gorgas Library one hour before kickoff; UA’s First Year Experience identifies it as the band and cheer squad’s pregame show.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled relative to kickoff; check the official gameday schedule for the specific game.

cards.title: Walk of Champions
cards.subtitle: North Endzone, Bryant-Denny Stadium
cards.notes: Plan to be outside the North Endzone 2.5 hours before kickoff to see this official gameday gathering and stadium approach.
cards.short_summary: A pregame stadium tradition tied to Bryant-Denny’s north endzone.
cards.evidence_claim: UA Gameday states that the Walk of Champions takes place outside Bryant-Denny Stadium’s North Endzone 2.5 hours before kickoff.
cards.access_notes: Timing is relative to kickoff; consult the official gameday schedule before traveling.

cards.title: Million Dollar Band
cards.subtitle: UA sporting events and football game days
cards.notes: Listen for the band during pregame and in the stadium; its music accompanies Alabama’s fight song and other cheering traditions.
cards.short_summary: UA’s more-than-century-old marching-band tradition is built into Crimson Tide game days.
cards.evidence_claim: UA First Year Experience says the Million Dollar Band has been a Crimson Tide tradition at sporting events and around campus for more than 100 years.
cards.access_notes: Performance details vary by event and game day.

cards.title: Sing “Yea, Alabama” After a Touchdown
cards.subtitle: Bryant-Denny Stadium game day
cards.notes: Join the fight song after an Alabama touchdown if attending a game; the Million Dollar Band provides the musical backing.
cards.short_summary: A stadium singalong that follows Alabama touchdowns.
cards.evidence_claim: UA First Year Experience calls singing the fight song after every Alabama touchdown a treasured Crimson Tide fan tradition.
cards.access_notes: Requires attendance at a football game; ticket requirements depend on the game.

cards.title: Hear the Noon Alma Mater at Denny Chimes
cards.subtitle: Denny Chimes, the Quad
cards.notes: Pause on the Quad around noon to hear the alma mater from Denny Chimes, then continue exploring the campus’s central green space.
cards.short_summary: Denny Chimes marks noon with UA’s alma mater.
cards.evidence_claim: UA states that Denny Chimes plays the alma mater daily at noon as a campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: The tower rings every quarter hour; the alma mater is identified by UA as a daily noon tradition.

cards.title: UA Ring Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Denny Chimes each spring
cards.notes: Eligible students can follow the spring ring-ceremony schedule: rings are placed inside Denny Chimes at 6:31 p.m. before formal presentation.
cards.short_summary: Class rings spend 24 hours inside Denny Chimes before the formal ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: UA says official class rings are placed inside Denny Chimes at 6:31 p.m. each spring, then presented 24 hours later in a formal ceremony.
cards.access_notes: For official UA class rings; timing is scheduled each spring.

cards.title: Form the Script A
cards.subtitle: Weeks of Welcome at Saban Field, Bryant-Denny Stadium
cards.notes: New students can look for the Weeks of Welcome activity that forms a campus-wide Script A on Saban Field for a shared photo.
cards.short_summary: Freshmen assemble into the Script A during Weeks of Welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: UA documents that freshmen form the Script A on Saban Field during Weeks of Welcome, creating a photo with new friends.
cards.access_notes: Designed for freshmen during Weeks of Welcome; confirm current programming through UA orientation communications.

cards.title: Tapping on the Mound
cards.subtitle: Historic Mound on the west side of the Quad
cards.notes: Visit the Quad during Honors Day to observe honor societies tap new members on the Historic Mound, following posted ceremony guidance.
cards.short_summary: UA honor societies publicly tap new members during Honors Day.
cards.evidence_claim: UA News describes the Tapping on the Mound ceremony for four University honor groups as one of UA’s longest-standing traditions.
cards.source_title: April 2026 Events in Bloom at UA
cards.access_notes: The 2026 listing placed it at 1:30 p.m. on April 3; future dates should be confirmed with UA.

cards.title: UA Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Campus and downtown Tuscaloosa in the fall
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming schedule for the pep rally, parade, lawn decorations, and other official activities coordinated by the student board.
cards.short_summary: A fall return-to-campus celebration with parade, pep rally, and student-led competitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UA describes Homecoming as a fall tradition welcoming alumni with a pep rally, bonfire, downtown parade, and Homecoming Queen crowning.
cards.access_notes: Events, routes, and participation requirements are set annually by UA Homecoming.

cards.title: Recite the Capstone Creed
cards.subtitle: Key University of Alabama events
cards.notes: Learn the Creed before a major campus event; its text focuses on knowledge, fairness, integrity, respect, responsibility, and excellence.
cards.short_summary: A shared pledge recited at key UA events.
cards.evidence_claim: UA identifies the Capstone Creed as a tradition recited at key events and says it affirms commitments to honor, integrity, and respect.
cards.access_notes: Occurrence depends on the event; consult the relevant event program.
